title: add-debug-logging-to-get_imports
request: could you add a debug log in get_imports so we can see how many imports it finds each time? just a logging.debug with the count would be fine.
reference_diff:
--- a/src/smolagents/_function_type_hints_utils.py
+++ b/src/smolagents/_function_type_hints_utils.py
@@ -37,6 +37,8 @@
     get_type_hints,
 )
 
+import logging
+
 
 IMPORT_TO_PACKAGE_MAPPING = {
     "wikipediaapi": "wikipedia-api",
@@ -83,6 +85,7 @@
     imports += re.findall(r"^\s*from\s+(\S+)\s+import", code, flags=re.MULTILINE)
     # Only keep the top-level module
     imports = [imp.split(".")[0] for imp in imports if not imp.startswith(".")]
+    logging.debug(f"Detected {len(imports)} imports: {imports}")
     return [get_package_name(import_name) for import_name in set(imports)]
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_get_imports_logging.py
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+import logging
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from smolagents._function_type_hints_utils import get_imports
+
+
+def test_get_imports_logs_debug():
+    code = """
+import os
+import sys
+from math import sqrt
+"""
+    with mock.patch.object(logging, "debug") as mock_debug:
+        imports = get_imports(code)
+    # Ensure the function still returns the correct imports (order may vary)
+    assert set(imports) == {"os", "sys", "math"}
+    # Verify that a debug message containing the count was emitted
+    assert mock_debug.called
+    logged_msg = mock_debug.call_args[0][0]
+    assert "Detected 3 imports" in logged_msg
